profile.summary: Senior JavaScript developer specializing in React-compatible ecosystems with deep expertise in TypeScript, testing, and performance optimization. Demonstrates advanced knowledge of React internals (lifecycle, VNode, hooks) and their replication in lightweight alternatives like Preact. Skilled in tooling (Babel, TypeScript compilation) and debugging edge cases with rigorous test coverage. Focuses on maintaining compatibility while improving performance and type safety.
